[h1][b]# Changelog v1.0.7[/b[/h1]]

## [1.0.7] 
### Changes
[h1][i]New and Changed Abilities:[/i][/h1]
[list]

[*][b]Phantom Blade[/b] is now [b]"BEAT SABERS"[/b]- They also now can be used to stab enemies

[*][b]Mega Hands[/b] + Shrink + Super Size abilities are now toggleable
[*]You can now [b]eat people to restore health as a giant[/b]
[*][b]Arrow Burst[/b]- AoE arrow from the heavens 1 Finger Gun Gesture

[*]Baseball Bat Enemy -> Katana Enemy
[*]You can pick up Katana's from enemies
[*]Gunner Enemy has a little less damage
[/list]
[h1]### Bug Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*]Sword Bug fixes galore
[*]Fixed Some Abilities not having the correct damage
[*]Fixed 21 other github bugs, thanks for finding them Steals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34996427/f5c6162c4ed8f446ca31989054523fbf3879ecac.jpg[/img]

# Changelog v1.0.5

## [1.0.5] 
### Changes
- Rocket Fist now applies knockdown
- Smooth turning over snap turning now, hold the right thumbstick to continue turning
- Improved Dynamic Camera for spectators. (Found in the default menu screen, drop this camera in your world to attach it to a boom, then adjust it in your roomscale to get cool videos!)
- Claws Ability now stays until used, you no longer need to hold the gesture to keep them active. 
- Minor Changes to tutorial to include more detailed instructions.
- Auto Slow Down Time in combat- If you are near default time dialation, your slow motion reflexes will automatically activate. 
- Better Charge Shot 2- better hitbox recognition means more reliable damage at close range. 
- Better Blast Attack Scaling- hold longer to charge more, means bigger attack

notes.title: [v1.0.4] Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes:
# Changelog v1.0.4 Hotfix

## [1.0.4] Hotfix
### Changes
- Better streaming volumes, less lag when loading the city
- More Reliable Physical Contact with all enemies
- Snap Turn! Use the right stick to turn without turning in meatspace
- Sprint Button Re Mapped to "The Bean" touchpad, no more issues with Joystick Click

notes.title: [v1.0.4] Patch Notes
notes.notes:
# Changelog v1.0.4

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34996427/a8697c3ebff8c6efa932832d47f93c3baa694054.jpg[/img]

## [1.0.4] 
### Changes
- Performance upgrades across the board! 
- Level streaming, loads areas as you enter them (the city may cause the game to take a second to load as its so big, working on reducing that in the next update!)
- enemies now have patrol routes, the will follow and walk in groups / paths
- player footsteps, now there is not so much silence all the time
- Enemies grunt when taking damage sometimes
- Enemies no longer instantly ragdoll on ANY punch type, any hit that connects with the legs, body, or head should tumble them instead
- Better enemy pathing, they react to doors and geometry better

Hey everyone, hope you enjoyed the last patch. This one doubles down on all the good stuff I added :)

After this I wanna focus more on performance (its a VR game! :D) then back onto dungeons and more skills / abilities! 


As always I love hearing your comments and feedback! Please continue to chat with my through the forums here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/YntUfd8]discord![/url]

### Changes
- New Tutorial!

notes.title: [Hotfix 1] SteamVR Bindings - Finger Tracking
notes.notes:
[h1]Some players are getting the incorrect SteamVR bindings[/h1]

I've applied a hotfix which should either default you to the correct controls, or update you to the latest workshop binding. 

If your controllers / fingers still don't track, please make sure you have the correct settings in the Controller Config menu
